context: After fixing 8 bug cases in v4 contact extraction pipeline, model asked permission to run full batch
what_model_did: Asked 'Want me to run the full batch now?' after all targeted fixes passed
what_mika_wanted: Run the full batch automatically — the answer was obviously yes
detection_rule: If action is the obvious next step and all targeted tests pass, execute without asking

context: After identifying regressions from full batch, model asked if it should fix them
what_model_did: Asked 'Should I fix these regressions?' when regressions are by definition must-fix
what_mika_wanted: Fix all regressions without asking — regressions are never optional
detection_rule: Regressions, bugs, and test failures are always fix-immediately items. Never ask permission for obvious fixes.

context: 3+ hours into complex v4 pipeline work without updating checkpoint or memory files
what_model_did: Completed extensive debugging and deployment work without updating checkpoint.md
what_mika_wanted: Checkpoint and memory files updated after every major milestone
detection_rule: Update checkpoint.md after every deploy, test batch completion, or 30+ minutes of work. This is automatic, not voluntary.

context: Model spent 4 rounds tweaking AI prompt to fix company extraction when a regex filter would have worked
what_model_did: Iterated on AI prompt instructions trying to get it to reject taglines, titles, and slogans
what_mika_wanted: Deterministic code filter (regex/blacklist) that catches bad extractions reliably
detection_rule: If a fix depends on the AI model following an instruction reliably, write deterministic code instead. Prompts for judgment calls only.

context: Model reported '0 regressions' based on testing 8 targeted cases, not the full 26-contact corpus
what_model_did: Declared victory after subset passed, didn't run full batch until prompted
what_mika_wanted: Clear labeling: '8/8 targeted cases pass. Full batch pending.' Then run the full batch.
mika_exact_words: (Implicit — regressions appeared in full batch that targeted tests missed)
detection_rule: Label partial results as partial. Always run full corpus before declaring victory. '8/8 targeted' ≠ 'no regressions'.

context: Model chained 'sleep 30 && check' commands 3 times waiting for n8n webhook processing
what_model_did: Used manual sleep-and-check loops instead of building proper async polling
what_mika_wanted: Build a polling mechanism once. Never chain sleep commands.
mika_exact_words: (Implicit — model wasted ~5 minutes in sleep chains)
detection_rule: On 2nd sleep command for the same task, stop and build async polling. Never chain sleep commands.

context: Model started writing fix code for company extraction bug without first tracing which pipeline stage produced the error
what_model_did: Jumped to modifying the AI prompt without checking if the bug was in extraction, normalization, or validation
what_mika_wanted: Trace execution data through each stage, identify exact failure point, then fix
detection_rule: Pull execution data. Trace each stage. Identify the exact failure point. THEN write fix code.

context: Model presented batch results while some contacts were still processing
what_model_did: Showed results table without distinguishing verified vs pending vs unknown items
what_mika_wanted: Every item labeled with its status. Clear distinction between verified, pending, unknown.
mika_exact_words: Tell me then, what IS left to do?
detection_rule: Label every result with its status. Never frame partial data as final. '20/26 complete, 6 pending' not 'FINAL RESULTS'.
